id.description: The unique identifier of the author.

did.description: The decentralized identifier (DID) of the author.

displayName.description: The display name of the author.

avatar.description: The URL of the author's avatar image.

id.description: The unique identifier of the shout.

parent.description: The ID of the parent shout if this is a reply, otherwise null.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the shout was created.

gif.description: An attached GIF, sticker, or clip.

facets.description: Mentions of other actors within the message, anchored to UTF-8 byte ranges.

mention.description: A mention of another actor within the shout message, anchored to a UTF-8 byte range in the message.

did.description: The DID of the mentioned actor.

byteStart.description: Inclusive UTF-8 byte offset of the mention start.

byteEnd.description: Exclusive UTF-8 byte offset of the mention end.

gif.description: A GIF, sticker, or clip embedded in a shout. `url` may point at an image (GIF/WebP) or a video (MP4); the client decides how to render it from the file extension.

url.description: Direct URL of the animated GIF/MP4.

width.description: The intrinsic width of the media in pixels.

height.description: The intrinsic height of the media in pixels.
